# Fluorescent lamp

`fluoro.json` is baked from "Weathered Fluorescent Light/Lamp - 4096px²" by Mark Peters
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/weathered-fluorescent-lightlamp-4096px2-5d29d2370ec846a2a461de351bba8872),
licensed CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: geometry quantised, base colour and emissive
textures reduced to 512 px, other textures dropped.
